title: Find the bug in an is_power_of_two function (hard)
prompt:
This function is supposed to return True if a number is a power of two but returns True for 0 as well, which is incorrect.

def is_power_of_two(n):
    return n & (n - 1) == 0

Identify the bug and explain the fix.

metadata.hard_reason: Requires correctly tracing bitwise logic: n=0 gives 0 & -1 == 0, a false positive. Real models sometimes struggle to trace bitwise operations correctly.
metadata.notes: Fix: add an explicit `n > 0` check, e.g. `return n > 0 and n & (n - 1) == 0`. Graded manually.
